name: Master Combat Performer
prerequisites: Performing Combatant or at least three performance feats, base attack bonus +6
benefit:
You can make performance combat checks as a free action. You are proficient in all weapons with the performance special quality.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 126
When you attempt a performance combat check, you can spend up to 5 stamina points to gain a bonus on the check equal to the number of stamina points you spent.
flavor: You are a master of the techniques and weapons of the arena and the stage.
